data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for reading and writing audio metadata and tags using Rust
data.what_it_does: metadata_god retrieves and updates metadata tags in local audio files, supporting formats such as MP3 (ID3v2.4), MP4/M4A, and FLAC (Vorbis comments). It uses flutter_rust_bridge and Cargokit to run native Rust audio tagging libraries under the hood. Developers can inspect or set track information, album details, and embedded cover artwork.
use_when: You need to read embedded metadata or album artwork from audio files on the local filesystem.
You need to edit, tag, or update metadata in MP3, M4A, MP4, or FLAC audio files.
avoid_when: You only need to play or stream audio without inspecting or altering file tags.
You are targeting web, as it relies on Rust FFI and local file access.
strengths: Supports both reading and writing metadata tags including embedded cover art.
Supports multiple desktop and mobile platforms via Rust FFI.
weaknesses: Requires `rustup` installed on the developer machine to build due to flutter_rust_bridge and Cargokit.
Format support documented is limited to mp3, m4a, mp4, and flac.
data.setup_notes: Requires rustup installed on the build machine. Android requires READ/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions configured in AndroidManifest.xml and requested at runtime.
